data_description.power_source: Declared: the value entered. Dedicated meter: measured. Calibration: "Calibrate" button measuring the grid difference for a few seconds.

autonomous.title: Standalone operation
autonomous.description:
Settings of the "Solar + guarantee" mode: if the sun was not enough, the water heater is heated during off-peak hours up to the target.

The router schedule already has an ON slot: {on_slot}. In that case the integration starts in "Solar only" so as not to heat twice.

untested_firmware.title: Firmware {version} not verified – {name}
untested_firmware.description:
Router {name} runs firmware {version}, not yet verified with this integration. Measurements and schedule are still read, but no forcing is sent.

Open an issue on GitHub (JVmaisGpeur/ha-routeur-f1atb) with the device diagnostics attached (passwords are redacted).
